description.p: Inkwell is a simple Markdown editor for local writing. It keeps files on your machine and does not include analytics, crash uploaders, updater pings, accounts, sync services, remote fonts, or remote app assets.
The editor provides a focused writing surface with Markdown-aware styling, dark and light themes, formatting controls, table tools, zoom controls, and adjustable page margins.

Adds a standard editor right-click menu for undo, redo, cut, copy, paste, paste as plain text, select all, and spelling suggestions, and fixes context-menu Paste so it inserts clipboard text directly.

Adds live selection statistics in the status bar so highlighted text reports exact word and character counts, and improves print output by rendering a sanitized document snapshot instead of printing the editor chrome.
Adds a macOS Open Recent submenu, tracks recently opened local documents, and prompts macOS users to make Inkwell their default Markdown editor without storing document contents.

Adds a refreshed Inkwell icon, expanded macOS menus, native macOS spelling suggestions, local grammar status checks, read-aloud controls, print/page/export commands, find and replace, and zoom status display.
Fixes table paste handling so tab-delimited spreadsheet data with pipe characters inside cells expands tables correctly instead of being misread as Markdown table syntax.
Fixes table undo and Markdown serialization when WebKit wraps table content in block-level containers, preserving table structure instead of flattening cells into plain text.
Fixes macOS keyboard handling by adding native AppKit menu routes for standard edit commands, advertised editor shortcuts, formatting shortcuts, and common app/window shortcuts.
Adds in-document Find with Ctrl+F, rendered-text matching, next and previous navigation, match counts, and dark-mode-consistent highlights.
Removes obsolete experimental native shell prototypes and stale platform packaging files from the public source tree so the repository matches the current Linux WebKit app.
Fixes new-document status so unsaved windows are clearly marked, and corrects rendered character counts so visual line breaks and structural table separators are not counted as characters.
Improves editor responsiveness while typing, reduces delayed Enter key-repeat behavior, and fixes rendered word counts so adjacent headings, paragraphs, lists, and table cells are counted correctly.
